text: Eight persons A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H sit around a circular table facing the centre, but not in the same order as given. E sits second to the left of F. C sits second to the right of F. F sits immediately to the left of H. E sits immediately to the right of G. D sits third to the right of F. B sits third to the left of C. What is the position of D with respect to G?
explanation: Going clockwise from A (everyone faces the centre, so clockwise is to the left) the order is A, D, C, H, F, B, E, G. D is at second to the left of G.
